grammar.title: Stronger addition with 不但...而且
grammar.explanation: 不但 (bùdàn) means "not only" and pairs with 而且 ("but also") to add a stronger second point a more emphatic version of plain 而且.

grammar.title: Talking it over with 商量
grammar.pattern: (主语) + 跟/和 + person + 商量
grammar.explanation: 商量 (shāngliang) means "to discuss, to talk something over" usually to reach a decision together, often marked with 跟 or 和 for who you're discussing it with.

sentences.zh: 他不但很认真，而且很努力。
sentences.pinyin: Tā búdàn hěn rènzhēn, érqiě hěn nǔlì.
sentences.en: He is not only serious, but also hard-working.

sentences.zh: 这个地方不但漂亮，而且安静。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dìfang búdàn piàoliang, érqiě ānjìng.
sentences.en: This place is not only beautiful, but also quiet.

sentences.zh: 他不但会说汉语，而且会说英语。
sentences.pinyin: Tā búdàn huì shuō Hànyǔ, érqiě huì shuō Yīngyǔ.
sentences.en: He can not only speak Chinese, but also English.

sentences.zh: 这本书不但有意思，而且有用。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū búdàn yǒu yìsi, érqiě yǒuyòng.
sentences.en: This book is not only interesting, but also useful.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ shāngliang yí jiàn shì.
sentences.en: I want to discuss something with you.

sentences.zh: 这件事我们商量商量吧。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒmen shāngliang shāngliang ba.
Nǐ yīnggāi xiān gēn jiārén shāngliang.
sentences.en: You should discuss it with your family first.
